title: eriogonum pauciflorum var. nebraskense
intro: Eriogonum pauciflorum var. nebraskense, commonly known as a variety of the silky lupine or Nebraska buckwheat, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Polygonaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels and improve wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help in soothing skin irritations and promoting tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of Eriogonum pauciflorum var. nebraskense include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
